FerryWellCo is an Amsterdam team bringing air-quality science, heat-stress research and spatial information into services people use for wellness, outdoor work and other settings. GOTime is its first working prototype for outdoor activity apps. Its interactive example uses stored conditions to suggest a next step for a planned run and explain why. Start at the [homepage](https://ferrywellco.com/) or the [GOTime page](https://ferrywellco.com/gotime/).

The [GOTime page](https://ferrywellco.com/gotime/) follows a fictional person's day, shows two screens from the prototype, and describes how a partner app might use the prototype API. The [science page](https://ferrywellco.com/science/) covers air pollution, heat and pollen. The [about page](https://ferrywellco.com/about/) introduces the team. The [privacy page](https://ferrywellco.com/privacy/) describes the email contact form.
